title: Evaluation of Swallowing in Patients With Obstructive Sleep Apnea
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the hypothesis that obstructive sleep apnea syndrome is associated with deviant pharyngeal swallowing function, using clinical, endoscopical and manometric evaluation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of obstructive sleep apnea syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

* other causes of dysphagia
* pharyngeal surgery
* prior treatment for obstructive sleep apnea
